results.revised_text: We used 5 mL of the catalyst suspension at 25 °C to test the activity, and the yield was 42%. The results suggest that doping improves the selectivity. However, the stability of the sample was not tested after 10 h.

revisions.revised: We used 5 mL of the catalyst suspension
revisions.reason: 时态与主谓一致；单位书写统一为 mL；补介词 of

revisions.original: The result prove that the doping is very effective and always improve the selectivity.
revisions.revised: The results suggest that doping improves the selectivity.
revisions.reason: 主谓一致；删除宣传化 very 与绝对化 always；prove 降为 suggest（限定强度不得加强，且原文仅为单一条件实验）

revisions.original: the stability of sample is not test after 10 h
revisions.revised: the stability of the sample was not tested after 10 h.
revisions.reason: 补冠词；被动语态 be + 过去分词；时态一致

glossary.note: 全篇统一；首次出现不加缩写
